questions.source: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2017 · Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix (Question Set I) Q4
questions.question_en: Which one of the following statements is correct?
options_en: Rights are claims of the State against the citizens.
Rights are privileges which are incorporated in the Constitution of a State.
Rights are claims of the citizens against the State.
Rights are privileges of a few citizens against the many.
questions.answer_source: Printed answer key in the Laxmikanth appendix (copied unchanged)

questions.source: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2017 · Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix (Question Set I) Q6
questions.question_en:
In the context of India, which one of the following is the correct relationship between Rights and
Duties?
options_en: Rights are personal and hence independent of society and Duties.
Rights, not Duties, are important for the advancement of the personality of the citizen.
Duties, not Rights, are important for the stability of the State.
questions.answer_source: Printed answer key in the Laxmikanth appendix (copied unchanged)

questions.source: UPSC Civil Services Prelims 2021 · Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix (Question Set I) Q12
questions.question_en:
With reference to India, consider the following statements:
1. There is only one citizenship and one domicile.
2. A citizen by birth only can become the Head of State.
3. A foreigner once granted the citizenship cannot be deprived of it under any circumstances.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.answer_source: Printed answer key in the Laxmikanth appendix (copied unchanged)
